name: Sea1 Offshore Inc.
summary: Sea1 Offshore Inc., together with its subsidiaries, owns and operates offshore support vessels for the offshore energy service industry. The company operates through Subsea Vessels; Anchor-Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) Vessels; Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs); Fast Crew & Oil Spill Recovery Vessels; and Other segments. It provides offshore vessel activities, such as anchor handling and towing, platform supply, oil spill recovery, well intervention services, and subsea operations.
